{{Wireless adapter |brand=Wistron NeWeb |model=DNUR-W7601 |fcc_date=03/14/2013 |is_manuf=No |if=USB (non-standard connector) |if_bus_version=2.0 |form_factor=module |fcc_id=NKR-DNURW7601 |ic_id=4441A-DNURW7601 |chip1_brand=MediaTek |chip1_model=MT7601U |accessible_UART=No |802dot11_protocols=bgn |txchains=1 |rxchains=1 |sstreams=1 |oui=00:6B:9E, CC:95:D7 }} This device is using MT7601U (MT7601UN).
"48DNUR28.SGA" is silkscreened on the board in the FCC photos. :"48DNUR28.0GA" is silkscreened on some production model boards.
There is a MAC label with a 00:6B:9E ('''VIZIO''') OUI on the board in the FCC external photos.
Some units have U.FL connectors.
This module appears to be used with the... *Vizio E320i-B2, E480i-B2, M471i-A2, M492i-B2, and probably others
